comment.narrative: The Baseline Total should correspond to the average emissions per capita in the 8 countries though the system doesnt allow for the average consideration but for the total sum. The country by country basis though is stated as the countrys per capita average.
As there is no data for 2023 Eurostad data from 2022 was used

The system doesnt allow for input of decimals. Numbers have been rounded.
